baselineUnexplainedResolution.landedFix: batch size derived from the rate limit, incomplete live reads never replace the stored measurement, and a failed pool is never stamped with a block version

broadcastSuccessRate.reason: the task broadcast nothing and the production database holds zero rows in all five broadcast tables, so there is no broadcast-success baseline to regress against

rootCausesFixed.detail: POOL_STATE_BATCH_SIZE reduced from 50 to 8 and the inter-chunk wait now covers the whole chunk; 9 of 24 extsload calls previously failed with -32007
a partial live read no longer mixes a failed half with a stored half; V4PoolState.complete marks a pool as a measurement only when both reads succeeded
a pool whose live read failed is no longer stamped with the pinned block, and a timestamp version is no longer treated as agreeing with a block version

scopeNote.reason: version 1 does not execute hook callbacks, so comparing the canonical V4 arithmetic to a hooked chain quote would measure hook behaviour; the frozen v1 scope already marks non-zero-hook pools as blocked
